digest.component_or_area: plan-review vocabulary and criteria heading detection
propositions: The codebase carries two synonym headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) for a single concept; all evaluation gates pool both and apply one bar, making the split vocabulary vestigial and harmful.

Criteria under ## Success Criteria are written as plain bullets and do not count toward the P1 blocking floor, cannot carry the [operator-attested] tag, and are not individually checkable via _count_ac_items.

Collapsing ## Success Criteria into ## Acceptance Criteria across detector regexes, reviewer prompts, routing indices, guides, test corpus, and 106 store tickets will tighten the gate and ensure all criteria are checkboxed and counted.

Three live files legitimately retain success-criteria vocabulary as excluded scope: plan_review_T2.md (trial metrics), plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable), and completion.py, which must not be modified by this migration.

All 106 store tickets carrying ## Success Criteria headings must be migrated so criteria sit under ## Acceptance Criteria as checkboxes, with zero SC headings remaining and grep verification confirming matches only at excluded sites and the vendor bundle.
